verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents a Sandbox project tied to the non-billable, unlimited Test Drive plan, which covers all Open Finance API endpoints. Testing runs against synthetic test banks (FinBanks), a test payroll provider (FinPayroll) and testing personas, so integrations can be exercised without real customer data. The official GitHub test project also generates a client from the API spec for testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox experience.
